theorems.name: Submission.deformation_velocity_acceleration_regularity
theorems.statement: (∀ (N : ℕ) (U K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U K φ → ContDiff ℝ 1 (initialVelocity φ) ∧ ∀ x ∉ K, initialVelocity φ x = 0) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (U K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), IsAdmissibleDeformation 3 U K φ → ContDiff ℝ 2 (initialVelocity φ) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (initialAcceleration φ) ∧ ∀ x ∉ K, initialVelocity φ x = 0 ∧ initialAcceleration φ x = 0
